# ====================================================================
# ATAC-seq Differential Accessibility Analysis with DiffBind
# ====================================================================
# Purpose: Identify chromatin regions with different accessibility 
#          between WT and KO conditions in cDC1 and cDC2 cells
# Method: DiffBind + DESeq2 + TMM normalization (as per paper)
# ====================================================================

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(DiffBind)      # Differential accessibility analysis
library(tidyverse)     # Data manipulation and visualization
```

```{r}
# Create output directory for results
dir.create("results/diffbind", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# PREPARE SAMPLE INFORMATION
# ====================================================================
# Create sample sheet for cDC1 samples
# This tells DiffBind where all files are and which group each sample belongs to

samples_cdc1 <- data.frame(
  SampleID = c("cDC1_WT_1", "cDC1_WT_2", "cDC1_KO_1", "cDC1_KO_2"),
  Condition = c("WT", "WT", "KO", "KO"),           # Experimental condition
  Replicate = c(1, 2, 1, 2),                       # Replicate number
  bamReads = paste0("results/", c("cDC1_WT_1", "cDC1_WT_2", "cDC1_KO_1", "cDC1_KO_2"), ".filtered.bam"),  # Filtered BAM files
  Peaks = paste0("results/", c("cDC1_WT_1", "cDC1_WT_2", "cDC1_KO_1", "cDC1_KO_2"), ".bed"),              # Individual peak files
  PeakCaller = "bed"                               # Peak file format
)

# Create sample sheet for cDC2 samples
samples_cdc2 <- data.frame(
  SampleID = c("cDC2_WT_1", "cDC2_WT_2", "cDC2_KO_1", "cDC2_KO_2"),
  Condition = c("WT", "WT", "KO", "KO"),
  Replicate = c(1, 2, 1, 2),
  bamReads = paste0("results/", c("cDC2_WT_1", "cDC2_WT_2", "cDC2_KO_1", "cDC2_KO_2"), ".filtered.bam"),
  Peaks = paste0("results/", c("cDC2_WT_1", "cDC2_WT_2", "cDC2_KO_1", "cDC2_KO_2"), ".bed"),
  PeakCaller = "bed"
)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# cDC1 ANALYSIS
# ====================================================================

# STEP 1: Load data
# Reads sample sheet and loads all peak files into a DiffBind object
dba_cdc1 <- dba(sampleSheet = samples_cdc1)

# STEP 2: Count reads in consensus peaks
# - Creates consensus peaks: peaks must appear in at least 2 samples (minOverlap = 2)
# - Counts how many ATAC-seq reads from each BAM file overlap each consensus peak
# - Normalizes with TMM (Trimmed Mean of M-values) to account for library size differences
# Result: Count matrix where rows = peaks, columns = samples
dba_cdc1 <- dba.count(dba_cdc1, minOverlap = 2, score = DBA_SCORE_TMM_MINUS_FULL)

# STEP 3: Set up comparison (WT vs KO)
# Tells DiffBind to compare samples by Condition (WT vs KO)
# Requires at least 2 samples per group (minMembers = 2)
dba_cdc1 <- dba.contrast(dba_cdc1, categories = DBA_CONDITION, minMembers = 2)

# STEP 4: Run statistical analysis with DESeq2
# - DESeq2 models count data with negative binomial distribution
# - Estimates variance between replicates
# - Calculates p-values to determine if differences are significant
# - bBlacklist/bGreylist = FALSE because we already filtered these regions
dba_cdc1 <- dba.analyze(dba_cdc1, method = DBA_DESEQ2, bBlacklist = FALSE, bGreylist = FALSE)

# STEP 5: Extract results
# - th = 1 means get ALL peaks (p-value < 1, i.e., everything)
# - bCounts = FALSE means don't include raw read counts (keeps file smaller)
# - Results include: coordinates, fold change (KO vs WT), p-value, FDR
diff_cdc1_df <- as.data.frame(dba.report(dba_cdc1, th = 1, bCounts = FALSE))

# Add column marking significant peaks (p < 0.01 as per paper)
diff_cdc1_df$significant <- diff_cdc1_df$p.value < 0.01

# STEP 6: Save results
# Save full results table with all statistics
write.csv(diff_cdc1_df, "results/diffbind/cdc1_diffbind_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Save only significant peaks as BED file for downstream analysis (motif finding, annotation, etc.)
write.table(diff_cdc1_df[diff_cdc1_df$p.value < 0.01, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc1_significant_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# cDC2 ANALYSIS
# ====================================================================
# Same steps as cDC1, but for cDC2 samples

# STEP 1: Load data
dba_cdc2 <- dba(sampleSheet = samples_cdc2)

# STEP 2: Count reads in consensus peaks
dba_cdc2 <- dba.count(dba_cdc2, minOverlap = 2, score = DBA_SCORE_TMM_MINUS_FULL)

# STEP 3: Set up comparison
dba_cdc2 <- dba.contrast(dba_cdc2, categories = DBA_CONDITION, minMembers = 2)

# STEP 4: Run statistical analysis
dba_cdc2 <- dba.analyze(dba_cdc2, method = DBA_DESEQ2, bBlacklist = FALSE, bGreylist = FALSE)

# STEP 5: Extract results
diff_cdc2_df <- as.data.frame(dba.report(dba_cdc2, th = 1, bCounts = FALSE))
diff_cdc2_df$significant <- diff_cdc2_df$p.value < 0.01

# STEP 6: Save results
write.csv(diff_cdc2_df, "results/diffbind/cdc2_diffbind_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(diff_cdc2_df[diff_cdc2_df$p.value < 0.01, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc2_significant_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ====================================================================
# Print summary statistics
# Shows total number of peaks analyzed and how many are significantly different
cat("cDC1: Total =", nrow(diff_cdc1_df), "| Sig (p<0.01) =", sum(diff_cdc1_df$p.value < 0.01), "\n")
cat("cDC2: Total =", nrow(diff_cdc2_df), "| Sig (p<0.01) =", sum(diff_cdc2_df$p.value < 0.01), "\n")

# ====================================================================
# BIOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION
# ====================================================================
# Positive fold change = peak is MORE accessible in KO compared to WT
# Negative fold change = peak is LESS accessible in KO compared to WT
# Significant peaks (p < 0.01) represent regions where chromatin 
# accessibility significantly changed due to the knockout
# ====================================================================
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 7: Separate GAIN and LOSS peaks for heatmap visualization
# ====================================================================

# For cDC1
# GAIN peaks: More accessible in KO (positive Fold > 0, significant)
gain_cdc1 <- diff_cdc1_df[diff_cdc1_df$Fold > 0 & diff_cdc1_df$p.value < 0.01, ]
write.table(gain_cdc1[, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc1_gain_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# LOSS peaks: Less accessible in KO (negative Fold < 0, significant)
loss_cdc1 <- diff_cdc1_df[diff_cdc1_df$Fold < 0 & diff_cdc1_df$p.value < 0.01, ]
write.table(loss_cdc1[, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc1_loss_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

cat("cDC1: Gain =", nrow(gain_cdc1), "| Loss =", nrow(loss_cdc1), "\n")

# For cDC2 (add after cDC2 analysis)
# GAIN peaks: More accessible in KO
gain_cdc2 <- diff_cdc2_df[diff_cdc2_df$Fold > 0 & diff_cdc2_df$p.value < 0.01, ]
write.table(gain_cdc2[, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc2_gain_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# LOSS peaks: Less accessible in KO
loss_cdc2 <- diff_cdc2_df[diff_cdc2_df$Fold < 0 & diff_cdc2_df$p.value < 0.01, ]
write.table(loss_cdc2[, c("seqnames", "start", "end")], 
            "results/diffbind/cdc2_loss_peaks.bed", 
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

cat("cDC2: Gain =", nrow(gain_cdc2), "| Loss =", nrow(loss_cdc2), "\n")
```
